reports.title: SINAPROC: 17,048 homes evaluated, 55,212 people affected, 4,428 in 135 shelters
reports.summary: SINAPROC preliminary report to 28 Oct: 17,048 homes evaluated, 55,212 people registered in affected communities, 4,428 people in 135 shelters; 619 schools, 120 health facilities, 127 government buildings, 44 churches, 22 bridges damaged; 66 road-damage reports.

reports.title: Government to build 2,700 homes: 1,400 added to 1,300 already started
reports.summary: On 27 Oct the Cabinet approved 1,400 more homes on top of 1,300 under way (2,700 total, could rise); temporary structures next to each home under construction; last keys due March 2027; MIVIOT to support repairs; youth hired via 'Mi Primer Empleo'.

reports.place: Herrera (Ocú, El Potrero) and Llano Grande
reports.title: Mulino: first 300 homes started in Herrera; Isla Cañas families offered relocation
reports.summary: President Mulino inspected construction of the first 300 homes in Herrera and 20 in Llano Grande (Veraguas); Pro Vivienda donated 50 homes and the First Lady's office will build 30. Water restored on Isla Cañas; ANATI surveying homes to offer relocation to the mainland.

reports.title: IGC-UP: 9,553 landslides mapped, 4,822 in the epicentral zone; 1,154 aftershocks
reports.summary: University of Panama Geosciences Institute preliminary balance to 28 Oct: 9,553 landslides identified (4,822 in the epicentral zone), up from 2,351 in the first week; 1,154 aftershocks recorded.

reports.title: MEDUCA: 85 schools must be rebuilt from scratch; target 3 March 2027
reports.summary: Education Minister Ventura Vega: 85 schools must be built entirely new, aiming for the 2027 school year starting 3 March; of 3,112 schools nationally, 619 affected and 35 destroyed. Veraguas teachers (AEVE) warn of learning gaps and propose early closure where schools are unsafe.

reports.title: M5.1 aftershock near Tonosí felt in Coclé; preventive evacuations, no new damage
reports.summary: IGC-UP: M5.1 aftershock at ~08:42–09:09 local on 29 Oct, 24 km NW of Tonosí, 8 km deep; felt strongly in Penonomé and Aguadulce, where some workplaces evacuated as a precaution. No new damage reported. Second M5+ in under 48 hours after the 27 Oct Coiba event.

reports.title: CSS: 86% of its facilities operating normally; 3 closed, 7 partially closed
reports.summary: Social Security Fund: 86% of facilities operate normally; Policlínica Presidente Remón, CAPPS Los Pozos and ULAPS Tonosí remain closed (care in modular units); 7 facilities partially closed; Soná and Aguadulce hospitals operate with restrictions.

reports.title: MICI: 75 firms report quake impacts; business groups say losses may be larger
reports.summary: Commerce ministry contacted 362 of 454 monitored firms in affected areas; 75 (21%) reported damage, lost sales or supply problems. Fedecámaras and UNPYME say informal-sector losses are not captured; no loss estimate yet.

reports.title: Germany delivers 60 tonnes of relief supplies
reports.summary: German Foreign Minister Wadephul arrived at Tocumen on 28 Oct with 60 tonnes of aid: 1,000 water filters, 780 kitchen sets, 900 tarpaulins, 512 blankets and 822 camp beds for families affected in Azuero.

reports.title: Photo: water and sand invade homes on Isla Cañas
reports.summary: Telemetro shows homes on Isla Cañas and in Cañas flooded with seawater and sand after the coast subsided; residents are split between returning and relocating to the mainland.
reports.image_caption: Debris and sand inside a flooded Isla Cañas home

reports.title: Photo: strong waves flood homes and businesses in Cañas
reports.summary: High tides and strong swells (SINAPROC warned of 17.4 ft tides) flooded land, homes and businesses in Cañas, already hit by quake-related subsidence; residents fear septic tanks will overflow.
reports.image_caption: Flooded homes and debris in Cañas

reports.title: Rain alert to 3 Nov for quake-hit provinces; landslide risk on damaged slopes
reports.summary: SINAPROC extended a rain and storm notice from 30 Oct to 3 Nov for Veraguas, Herrera, Los Santos and Coclé, with 120–200 mm possible over three days and high waves on the Azuero coast; officials warn of landslides and access problems.

reports.title: Atalaya basilica: tower and belfry partly collapsed; restoration may take a year
reports.summary: Parts of the upper tower and belfry collapsed and interior niches were damaged; possible partial demolition is being assessed and restoration could take about a year. MiCultura is following 45 heritage and cultural sites affected by the quake.

reports.title: Moody's: limited fiscal cost (~US$100M, ~0.1% of GDP); no rating impact expected
reports.summary: Moody's lead analyst for Panama said fiscal cost is limited, based on MEF spending needs of up to about US$100M (~0.1% of GDP), and does not expect a significant effect on the Baa3 (negative) rating; review due in November.
